english.title: Fail to comply with a passport surrender requirement in a SHPO

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: antisocial behaviour crime and policing act 2014

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a requirement under section 103D(4) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 to surrender all your passports at **(..SPECIFY POLICE STATION..), as required by a sexual harm prevention order made at **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE ORDER WAS MADE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 103I(2) and (3) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being subject to a SHPO prohibiting travelling to a country outside UK
Fail to comply with a requirement under section 103D(4) to surrender passport at a police station

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence no longer applies from the 28th November 2022 due to changes made by the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictable: maximum 5 years imprisonment

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None
